provenance.summary: Engineering heuristic defaults chosen from common photo-quality practice and checked only against the synthetic fixtures in services/vision/tests. They have NOT been calibrated on real field photos.
provenance.recalibration: Recalibrate every threshold on licensed, consented field photos with reviewer accept/retake outcomes before relying on it for automation (blueprint pages 050, 083, 087). Publish the new file under a new version; never edit a released version in place.

analysis.note: Metrics are computed on a BOX-downsampled copy whose long side is at most this many pixels, so values are comparable across camera resolutions.

blur.note: Variance of the 4-neighbour Laplacian on 8-bit luma at analysis size. ~100 is a widely used rule of thumb for 'acceptably sharp' at roughly 1000 px; 40 marks clearly unusable motion blur or missed focus.

exposure.note: Mean luma on 0-255 plus the p95-p5 spread. Concrete in daylight typically sits mid-scale; the band limits flag night shots and blown-out frames.

glare.note: Share of analysis pixels whose darkest RGB channel is >= clipLevel (specular glare, sun on wet concrete, flash on a ruler).

resolution.note: Short side after EXIF orientation. Ruler graduations and curb edges need detail; modern phone cameras exceed the warn level by a wide margin.

aspect.note: Long/short side ratio (4:3 = 1.33, 16:9 = 1.78; panoramas and slivers exceed the limits) and flat black/white edge bands that indicate screenshots, padding, or edited crops.

duplicate.note: Hamming distance between 64-bit dHashes. <= nearIdentical: same shot (re-encode, resize, burst frame); <= similar: likely the same view. Exact byte duplicates are detected by SHA-256.
